messages:
marco: Heads up — planning a narrow publish window in ~15m for py & ts SDKs. We need pinflip + release notes finalization. @sylvie can you run checksum/publish preflight? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: [1766004380] publishing artifacts: redwood-python-sdk v1.12.0-canary -> registry

sylvie: running checks now. will post sha and wheels. if anything fails we hold

sylvie: checksum mismatch on wheel for python: expected abc123 got a1b2c3

sylvie: log snippet:
```
UPLOAD ERROR: 403 Forbidden
tooling:upload: checksum mismatch for dist/redwood_python-1.12.0-py3-none.whl
```

marco: ugh. rollback criteria? if checksum mismatch -> abort GA and keep canary tag

tia: agree. hold GA, don't flip dist-tag. create hotfix branch? @jordan can you update release notes to mark GA delayed

jordan: will update notes. adding section:
- Delay GA for py wheel checksum investigation
- Action: republish with signed wheel or roll back to 1.11.3 if needed

deploy-bot: [1766004460] publish FAILED: 1 artifact failed -> aborting release

marco: ok hold. apply pin on registries: npm dist-tag -> keep 'latest' at 1.11.3, py dist-tag 'latest' -> 1.11.3. pls confirm

sylvie: pin applied for python: `pip index set latest=1.11.3` (mock). npm pinned by ops

tia: spin up a quick patch branch, cut 1.11.4-hotfix only if we cannot sign the wheel. timeline? 30–45m

jordan: release notes updated and drafted blurb for changelog + internal email

deploy-bot: [1766004550] rollback marker created: rb-1766004550. Canary routes reverted to 1.11.3

marco: thanks all. follow-ups: sylvie to triage signing/service, tia to coordinate hotfix cut if needed, jordan to finalize note. I'll call a short postmortem after the window.

sylvie: started forensics on upload service and wheel builder

jordan: internal announcement draft ready, sending to #marketing for review

marco: closing the window early. re-open plan tomorrow same window unless hotfix required. :white_check_mark:
